text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Listen, listen! You know how yesterday was 
our day off? I met such an adorable black 
cat at the park!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
While I was drawing a magic circle on the 
ground, they kept scuttling around right 
at my feet... heheh!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"It must have realized I'm a witch. Maybe 
it wanted to become my familiar...!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fufun! I'm in a good mood, so I'll put in 
some extra effort during today's training!
